kaps_punt: Oplossings: oplossings is ook mengsels; sommige oplossings kan gemaak word deur die vermenging van 'n vaste en 'n vloeistof soos suiker en water, sout en water; oplossings is eenvormig in voorkoms en die vastestowwe kan nie gesien word na vermenging nie. Onoplosbare stowwe: Sommige vastestowwe sal nie 'n oplossing in die water vorm nie (onoplosbare vastestowwe).

items.bewering: Jy weet al wat 'n mengsel is: twee of meer stowwe wat saam gemeng is.
items.bron: EBSCO Research Starters 'Mixture (chemistry)'; Chemistry LibreTexts 2.7 'Mixture' (CK-12): a mixture is a physical combination of two or more substances that keep their identities.

items.bewering: Gooi nou 'n teelepel suiker in 'n glas water en roer goed. Na 'n rukkie sien jy geen suikerkorrels meer nie. Tog is die water en die suiker albei nog in die glas. Daarom is suikerwater ook 'n mengsel wat ons 'n oplossing noem.
items.bron: OpenStax Chemistry 2e 11.1 'The Dissolution Process' and 11.5 'Colloids' (a solution is a homogeneous mixture; dissolved molecules are invisible); sucrose solubility about 175-180 g per 100 mL water even at 0 C (Wikipedia 'Sucrose'), so a teaspoon in a glass dissolves completely.

items.bewering: Om 'n vaste stof in 'n vloeistof te meng is een manier om 'n oplossing te maak. Suiker en water is een paar, en sout en water is nog een.
items.bron: Harper College 'Solutions, Suspensions, and Colloids' (Chemistry for the Health Sciences); OpenStax Chemistry 2e 11.5: saltwater and sugar water are standard solid-in-liquid solutions. 'Een manier' correctly leaves room for other kinds of solution.

items.bewering: Strooi 'n teelepel sout in 'n glas water en roer. Die wit korrels word al hoe kleiner tot jy hulle nie meer sien nie. Ons sê dan die sout het opgelos.
items.bron: OpenStax Chemistry 2e 11.1 (ionic solid dissolving: particles leave the crystal surface, so crystals shrink until gone); NaCl solubility about 36 g per 100 g water at room temperature (Sigma-Aldrich solubility table), far above a teaspoon per glass.

items.bewering: Ons noem 'n oplossing eenvormig omdat dit oral in die houer dieselfde lyk. Jy sien ook geen korrels van die vaste stof meer nie.
items.bron: OpenStax Chemistry 2e 11.5 'Colloids': a solution is homogeneous, the dissolved molecules or ions are invisible.

items.bewering: 'n Oplossing is deursigtig, en dit beteken jy kan daardeur sien. Dit mag wel 'n kleur hê.
items.bron: OpenStax Chemistry 2e 11.5 / Lumen 'Colloids': 'A solution may be colored, but it is transparent'.

items.bewering: Rooibostee sonder melk is rooibruin en tog kan jy daardeur sien.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Rooibos'; Twinings 'Redbush, Rooibos - African Red Tea Explained': brewed rooibos is a clear reddish-brown infusion.

items.bewering: Roer 'n teelepel suiker in jou tee tot jy geen korrels meer sien nie. Die eerste sluk is net so soet soos die laaste. Die suiker is dus oral in die tee al sien jy dit nie.
items.bron: OpenStax Chemistry 2e 11.1; CK-12 'Solutions' (a solution's dissolved particles are spread evenly, so composition and taste are the same throughout). Holds for sugar stirred until dissolved, which is exactly the condition the sentence sets. Not a superlative ('eerste' here means the first sip, not a record).

items.bewering: In die volgende les leer jy hoe om sout uit soutwater terug te kry.
items.bron: The underlying fact (dissolved salt can be recovered, e.g. by evaporating the water) is standard: Wikipedia 'Saline water' / evaporation of brine for salt. What the next lesson contains is curriculum sequencing, outside the fact check.

items.bewering: Party mense sê die suiker het in die tee gesmelt, maar dit is verkeerd.
items.bron: Geeky Girl Engineer 'It's Not Melting, It's Dissolving'; MCQ.SG 'Melting vs Dissolving': the everyday phrase is a recognised misconception; sucrose does not melt near tea temperature (it decomposes/caramelises around 186 C).

items.bewering: Smelt gebeur wanneer een stof warm word en self 'n vloeistof word. 'n Blokkie ys in die son smelt en word water.
items.bron: Britannica 'Melting': change of a solid into a liquid when heat is applied; ice to water is the standard example.

items.bewering: Vir oplos het jy twee stowwe nodig wat saam gemeng word, soos suiker en water. Suiker los ook in koue water op sonder dat iets verhit word. Die suiker word nie self 'n vloeistof nie, maar versprei deur die water.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Sucrose': 100 mL water dissolves about 175 g sucrose at 0 C, so sugar dissolves in cold water; OpenStax Chemistry 2e 11.1: solute particles disperse among solvent particles rather than becoming a liquid themselves.

items.bewering: Sommige vaste stowwe vorm nie 'n oplossing in water nie. Ons sê hulle is onoplosbaar, en sand is een voorbeeld.
items.bron: CK-12 Flexi 'Can sand dissolve in water?'; Britannica 'Silica mineral': quartz solubility in pure water at 25 C is about 6 ppm, i.e. insoluble for every practical purpose.

items.bewering: Mieliemeel en meel los ook nie in water uit die kraan op nie. Dieselfde geld vir mielieblom en stampmielies in water uit die kraan.
items.bron: CK-12 Flexi 'Is flour soluble in water?' (flour forms a suspension, not a solution); British Pharmacopoeia 'Maize Starch' (practically insoluble in cold water); ScienceBob 'Oobleck' (cornflour granules are insoluble in cold water and settle); Wikipedia 'Mielie meal' (coarse maize flour). Samp is coarse broken maize kernels and plainly does not dissolve. The 'water uit die kraan' qualifier is apt: heat gelatinises starch, which is still not dissolving, and the lesson does not claim otherwise.

items.bewering: Kerriepoeier en vlapoeier gee die water 'n kleur, maar die meeste van die poeier los nie op nie.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Custard powder' and CooksInfo 'Custard Powder': mainly cornflour plus a little colouring (annatto) and flavouring, so the bulk is insoluble starch while the colour tints the water; curcumin, turmeric's pigment and the main colour in curry powder, is practically insoluble in water (PMC11766122; PubMed 27507487), so the spice stays as particles. 'Die meeste' is the correct hedge.

items.bewering: Roer 'n lepel meel in 'n glas water. Die water word troebel en jy kan nie meer mooi daardeur sien nie. As die glas 'n rukkie staan, sak die meeste meel stadig na die bodem.

items.bron: Profound Physics 'Does Flour Dissolve In Water?' and CK-12 Flexi: flour gives a milky, cloudy suspension that settles to the bottom on standing.

items.bewering: By sand en stampmielies sien jy die stukkies gou op die bodem lê.
items.blok: Wat jy by 'n onoplosbare stof sien
items.bron: CK-12 Flexi 'Can sand dissolve in water?': sand is denser than water and settles; samp kernels are large and dense and sink at once.

items.bewering: Kerriepoeier en vlapoeier maak die water ook troebel, en die meeste poeier sak uit.
items.blok: Wat jy by 'n onoplosbare stof sien
items.bron: Cornstarch (the bulk of custard powder) is insoluble in cold water and settles (ScienceBob 'Oobleck'; arXiv 1303.5116 notes starch granules of density about 1.6 g/cm3 settle rapidly in water); curcumin-bearing spice particles are insoluble (PMC11766122).

items.bewering: 'n Oplossing bly deursigtig, en niks sak daarin uit nie.
items.blok: Wat jy by 'n onoplosbare stof sien
items.bron: OpenStax Chemistry 2e 11.5: in a solution the dissolved species are transparent and 'do not settle out on standing'.

items.bewering: 'n Stof is oplosbaar as dit in water kan oplos, soos suiker en sout. 'n Stof is onoplosbaar as dit nie in water oplos nie.
items.blok: Hoe jy die twee uitmekaar ken
items.bron: OpenStax Chemistry 2e 11.1 / Wikipedia 'Sucrose' and NaCl solubility data. Solubility strictly depends on the solvent; the lesson defines it throughout for water, which matches the curriculum bullet's own framing ('nie 'n oplossing in die water vorm nie') and is true as stated in that frame.

items.bewering: Die stof is oplosbaar as die water deursigtig en oral dieselfde bly. Die stof is onoplosbaar as jy dit nog sien of dit na die bodem sak.
items.blok: Hoe jy die twee uitmekaar ken
items.bron: OpenStax Chemistry 2e 11.5 and Harper College 'Solutions, Suspensions, and Colloids': solutions are transparent, homogeneous and do not settle; suspensions show visible particles and settle. With a teaspoon per glass (the stated amount) the test sorts every substance in the lesson correctly, including curry and custard powder, which tint the water but stay visible and settle.

items.bewering: oplos: Wanneer die deeltjies van 'n stof losraak en tussen die deeltjies van 'n vloeistof meng, sodat jy geen korrels meer kan sien nie.
items.bron: OpenStax Chemistry 2e 11.1 'The Dissolution Process': solute particles separate from the solid and disperse among solvent particles. Read alone, the entry does not also fit melting, since it requires a second substance.

items.bewering: oplossing: 'n Mengsel waarin een stof in 'n vloeistof opgelos het. Dit lyk oral dieselfde.
items.bron: OpenStax Chemistry 2e 11.5; Wikipedia 'Mixture': a solution is a homogeneous mixture. Liquid-solvent scope is a simplification (alloys and air are also solutions) but not a falsehood; 'een stof' reads as 'a substance', not 'exactly one'.

items.bewering: oplosbaar: Iets wat in water kan oplos, soos suiker en sout.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Sucrose' (about 200 g per 100 mL at 25 C); Sigma-Aldrich solubility table (NaCl about 36 g per 100 g water). Water-scoped, consistent with the lesson and the curriculum bullet.

items.bewering: onoplosbaar: Iets wat nie in water oplos nie, soos sand.
items.bron: CK-12 Flexi 'Can sand dissolve in water?'; Britannica 'Silica mineral' (quartz about 6 ppm in water at 25 C).

items.bewering: smelt: Wanneer 'n vaste stof warm word en in 'n vloeistof verander.
items.bron: Britannica 'Melting'; Chemistry LibreTexts 13.11 'Melting'.

items.bron: OpenStax Chemistry 2e 11.5; Vaia 'What does it mean to say that a solution is a homogeneous...': uniform throughout.

items.bewering: deursigtig: Wanneer jy deur iets kan sien, soos deur skoon glas.
items.bron: Standard meaning of 'transparent' as used by OpenStax Chemistry 2e 11.5 for solutions ('transparent'); clean glass is the textbook example of a transparent material.

items.bewering: troebel: Wanneer 'n vloeistof vol klein stukkies is en nie meer helder is nie.
items.bron: Profound Physics 'Does Flour Dissolve In Water?' and OpenStax Chemistry 2e 11.5: suspended undissolved particles make a liquid cloudy/opaque.

opsomming: Every claim in the lesson checks out against sources: it has no superlatives and no comparison blocks, dissolving is correctly kept apart from melting, and all six insoluble examples (sand, flour, maize meal, cornflour, samp, and curry and custard powder hedged as 'mostly') are right. An Afrikaans search returned a Siyavula textbook page and a homework site, and neither was opened or used.
